raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Setting `CheckpointConfig.ckpt_load_validate_sharding_integrity=False` currently still sends `validate_access_integrity=True` to Core's global checkpoint loader and save path. The fully-parallel save wrapper also retains its default validation policy. This leaves the inherited checkpoint configuration ineffective in supported recipe training.

Forward the policy to the global loader and to both save layers when the installed Core wrapper supports the save-side option. Preserve the development pin's load-only semantics, cached constant-structure behavior, and existing MIMO exceptions. Constructor capability is checked once at import.

Bases: Bridge `b1bb0a97ec5aad323eb2dd666e3f69aaebc1daff`; upstream Core main `a98aed553e25b4e86c59f50be54ac0ea4227b442`. Bridge's pinned Core: `e30d863a6d82a3c45f2d71355dc73fbf5610967b`. Development pin: `4a4de865795f123eda422ebf0a4c13d2418cf3cb`.

Source changes: https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/pull/4422 and https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/pull/5554. Related Bridge PR 6192 handles content-hash verification, a separate contract.

Validation on unchanged production base with test-only additions, then on this fix:

```bash
uv run python -m pytest tests/unit_tests/training/test_checkpointing.py -k 'save_checkpoint_global or global_checkpoint_load_honors_sharding_validation' -q -p no:cacheprovider
```

Before: exit 1, 11 failed and 53 passed; failure anchor `assert True is False`. After: exit 0, 64 passed. Cases include both policy values, first/cached saves, constant structure, MIMO, and a strict legacy save-wrapper constructor.

```bash
uv run python -m pytest tests/unit_tests/training/test_checkpointing.py -k 'TestSaveCheckpoint or TestCheckpointPathOverride or global_checkpoint_load_honors_sharding_validation' -q -p no:cacheprovider
uv run pre-commit run --all-files
```

Adjacent: exit 0, 87 passed and one skipped. All-files hooks: exit 0, no modified files. Native CPU unit fixtures mock checkpoint I/O and distributed calls. No multi-rank resume, full development-pin runtime, or performance result is claimed.

`uv run mypy --strict src/megatron/bridge/training/checkpointing.py tests/unit_tests/training/test_checkpointing.py` exits 2 with the same mypy 2.2.0 internal error on unchanged and patched sources; no type-check pass is claimed.

+    expected_validation = validate_sharding and not (is_mimo and not fully_parallel)
+    assert load.call_args.kwargs["validate_access_integrity"] is expected_validation
